assertions.text: The policy states: An evaluation and management visit billed on the same day as a minor procedure by the same provider is paid only when modifier 25 is appended to the visit code and the record documents a significant, separately identifiable evaluation.

citations.quote: An evaluation and management visit billed on the same day as a minor procedure by the same provider is paid only when modifier 25 is appended to the visit code and the record documents a significant, separately identifiable evaluation.

assertions.text: The policy states: The evaluation is separately identifiable when the record shows work beyond the assessment that is a routine part of the procedure: for example, evaluation of a different problem, or of a new problem that required a history, an examination and a treatment decision before the procedure was chosen.

citations.quote: The evaluation is separately identifiable when the record shows work beyond the assessment that is a routine part of the procedure: for example, evaluation of a different problem, or of a new problem that required a history, an examination and a treatment decision before the procedure was chosen.

assertions.text: The record states: Blood pressure review: home readings have been running 150 to 160 systolic for a month, with morning headaches.

citations.quote: Blood pressure review: home readings have been running 150 to 160 systolic for a month, with morning headaches.

assertions.text: The record states: Examination: blood pressure 162/95, repeated after rest; heart sounds normal; no ankle swelling.

citations.quote: Examination: blood pressure 162/95, repeated after rest; heart sounds normal; no ankle swelling.

assertions.text: The record states: Decision: lisinopril increased from 10 mg to 20 mg; kidney function to be checked in two weeks.

citations.quote: Decision: lisinopril increased from 10 mg to 20 mg; kidney function to be checked in two weeks.
